nodes.text: Is it true that\[\mathrm{ex}(n; K_{r,r}) \gg n^{2-1/r}?\]

#714 : [Er64c] [Er67b] [Er69] [Er71,p.103] [Er74c,p.77] [Er75] [Er81] [Er93,p.334] graph theory | turan number Kövári, Sós, and Turán [KST54] proved\[\mathrm{ex}(n; K_{r,r}) \ll n^{2-1/r}\]for all $r\geq 2$. Brown [Br66] and, independently, Erdős, Rényi, and Sós [ERS66] , proved the conjectured lower bound when $r=3$. When $r=2$ it is known that\[\mathrm{ex}(n;K_{2,2})=\left(\frac{1}{2}+o(1)\right)n^{3/2}\](see [768] , since $K_{2,2}=C_4$). See also [147] . The generalisation to hypergraphs is [1158] .
